summary: Implementation plan for building 5 executable flywheel workflows from Diandra Escobar's LinkedIn growth system. Includes 3 LinkedIn-specific flywheels (/diandra-growth-sprint, /diandra-content-engine, /diandra-steal-and-remix) and 2 universal versions (/jackpost, /growth-format-sprint). Each flywheel follows the research → produce → assemble → quality-gate architecture established by /mini-brief and /ip-flywheel.
